about.heading: About Me
about.title: Building Secure Digital Solutions
about.description: I am Arnold Peter Mukasa, a Full Stack Software Developer and Network/Cloud Engineer currently studying at Makerere University. I hold a Diploma in Computer Science from Makerere University Business School (MUBS) (2024). I am a passionate software developer specializing in building exceptional digital experiences. With a strong foundation in web development and a keen eye for design, I create seamless and engaging applications that delight users. I acquired a Digital Marketing certificate from Great Learning (2023), which enhanced my understanding of online marketing strategies and tools. I also hold a CompTIA Security+ certification from ISBAT University, which equipped me with essential knowledge and skills in cybersecurity, including risk management, threat analysis, and security controls. During my free time I enjoy playing chess, reading books, and learning new technologies. I am always eager to take on new challenges and collaborate with like-minded individuals to create innovative solutions that make a positive impact in the world. I enjoy building scalable applications, cloud infrastructure, networking solutions, and modern digital experiences.
